record_scope_reconstruction: January 17 2024 road protest blocked DN1F at Urziceni in both directions toward Vállaj, Hungary. This is not the Ukraine frontier, notwithstanding a misleading news classification.

source_checks.finding: Original local report quotes INFOTRAFIC: DN1F entry and exit blocked near customs, then reopened after prefect talks later that day.
Original police directory explicitly lists Urziceni–Vállaj among Satu Mare road crossings on the Hungarian frontier.

OSM node is the shared vertex of DN1F way 127436685 and named Romania–Hungary boundary way 102143833, checked in the raw map extract. It is a route/boundary junction, not a named customs booth; police directory independently identifies Urziceni–Vállaj road pair.
